lines.en: Despite the delay, we enjoyed the trip, Luisa. Although the flight was late, the weekend was wonderful.
lines.pt: Apesar do atraso, curtimos a viagem, Luisa. Embora o voo tenha atrasado, o fim de semana foi maravilhoso.

lines.en: Absolutely. In spite of the rain, we walked all over the city. Although my shoes were soaked, I felt happy.
lines.pt: Com certeza. Apesar da chuva, andamos pela cidade toda. Embora meus sapatos estivessem encharcados, me senti feliz.

lines.en: Despite losing my phone on the first day, I took great photos with yours. Although I was stressed, I relaxed quickly.
lines.pt: Apesar de perder meu celular no primeiro dia, tirei ótimas fotos com o seu. Embora estivesse estressada, relaxei rápido.

lines.en: In spite of the crowds, the museum was impressive. Even though we queued for an hour, it was worth it.
lines.pt: Apesar da multidão, o museu foi impressionante. Mesmo tendo esperado uma hora na fila, valeu a pena.

lines.en: And despite the high prices, the food was delicious. Although the hotel was small, our room had a lovely view.
lines.pt: E apesar dos preços altos, a comida estava deliciosa. Embora o hotel fosse pequeno, nosso quarto tinha uma vista linda.

lines.en: That is true. In spite of being exhausted, I woke up early on Sunday to see the market. It was lively!
lines.pt: É verdade. Apesar de estar exausta, acordei cedo no domingo para ver o mercado. Estava animado!

lines.en: Although I hate flying, I might do it again. Despite the turbulence, the view above the clouds was beautiful.
lines.pt: Embora eu odeie voar, talvez faça de novo. Apesar da turbulência, a vista acima das nuvens era linda.

lines.en: Despite what our friends said, Atlanta is a friendly city. Although people say it is too busy, I disagree.
lines.pt: Apesar do que nossos amigos disseram, Atlanta é uma cidade simpática. Embora digam que é movimentada demais, discordo.

lines.en: I agree. In spite of all the problems, I would go back tomorrow. Although I would pack lighter next time.
lines.pt: Concordo. Apesar de todos os problemas, eu voltaria amanhã. Embora fosse levar menos bagagem da próxima vez.

lines.en: Same here. Despite feeling tired, I want to write a review online. Although nobody reads reviews, I enjoy writing them.
lines.pt: Eu também. Apesar de cansada, quero escrever uma avaliação online. Embora ninguém leia avaliações, gosto de escrevê-las.

lines.en: Good plan. Despite the delay, you can add that the airline staff were kind. Look, they are calling our gate!
lines.pt: Bom plano. Apesar do atraso, você pode dizer que a equipe da companhia foi gentil. Olha, estão chamando nosso portão!

facts.big: despite / in spite of + nome ou -ing; although + oração
facts.label: Contraste
facts.sub: Despite the delay, we enjoyed it. In spite of being tired, I went. Although it rained, we walked. Sem of depois de despite.

facts.label: Apesar de
facts.sub: Despite the rain, we walked. Depois de despite vem substantivo ou -ing: Despite feeling tired. Não coloque of: Despite of está errado. Nem uma oração completa.

facts.label: Mesmo sentido
facts.sub: In spite of é igual a despite, mas leva of. In spite of the crowds, it was great. Use qualquer um conforme o texto: despite é mais curto, in spite of soa mais enfático.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Despite is followed by a noun or -ing.

items.why: Despite has no of; in spite of has of.

items.s: Although is followed by subject + verb.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Despite is followed by a noun or -ing. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “Despite of the rain”. → Falso (Despite has no of; in spite of has of.)
Although is followed by subject + verb. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Despite everything · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a Sunday afternoon at Atlanta airport. Elena and Luisa are going home. Their weekend trip had many problems. The flight was late and it rained a lot. But they are smiling. They remember the good moments.

“Despite the delay, we enjoyed the trip, Luisa. Although the flight was late, the weekend was wonderful.” says Elena. “Absolutely. In spite of the rain, we walked all over the city. Although my shoes were soaked, I felt happy.” says Luisa. “Despite losing my phone on the first day, I took great photos with yours. Although I was stressed, I relaxed quickly.” says Elena.
